needs.subject_requirement: One source file represented as a stable node under the requested project subject; source identity is versioned by the content snapshot.
needs.context_requirement: Preserve project root, source identity, language, and syntax-only interpretation limits.
needs.current_source_requirement: Evidence content_state must equal the scanned source snapshot; older snapshots remain stored but are not current.
needs.coverage_requirement: Identify the exact source file and declare the observed syntax scope; do not imply descendant or runtime completeness.

needs.subject_requirement: Enumerate module, class, function, async-function and import declarations for Python; enumerate module, function, struct, enum, trait, impl, type, const/static and use declarations for Rust.
needs.context_requirement: Record source language and explicitly state that syntax inventory does not establish runtime behavior.
needs.current_source_requirement: Each declaration observation must carry a digest of the exact source text and the source snapshot content_state.
needs.coverage_requirement: Return all supported declaration forms in the file or an explicit parse gap; unsupported syntax semantics must not be guessed.

needs.subject_requirement: State the observed file boundary and language-specific parser limits for the source node.
needs.context_requirement: Include language and parser method in the assertion context and limitations.
needs.current_source_requirement: Boundary assertions are current only for the exact content digest being scanned.
needs.coverage_requirement: Explicitly distinguish supported syntax coverage from unverified type, macro, runtime, or behavioral semantics.

needs.subject_requirement: Provide source-relative line locators for each supported declaration observation and a file identity locator.
needs.context_requirement: Evidence must include source_id, content_state, source kind, content digest and supports/refutes relation.
needs.current_source_requirement: Every locator must be tied to the exact scanned file bytes; a source change creates a new snapshot.
needs.coverage_requirement: Every reported name must have at least one evidence locator; never synthesize line numbers for non-source evidence.
